Indumentum of simple, short (stalked), glandular, or stellate (star-liked), pale brown to rusty hairs (visible under microscope). Habitat, ecology and phenology: — Ardisia patentiradiosa inhabits a bank of a small forest river. It was found on an islet between two river arms, above a local waterfall. This area represents an outcrop of a basalt bed; it experiences temporary flooding and is overmoistured all year round. Flowering in (March –) April.
